name: Question 7
worked_solution:
We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product:

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}0 & -4 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 & -3 \\ -1 & 2 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}8 \\ 4 \\ 2\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}0\cdot 8+(-4)\cdot 4+1\cdot 2 \\ 1\cdot 8+2\cdot 4+(-3)\cdot 2 \\ (-1)\cdot 8+2\cdot 4+4\cdot 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0-16+2 \\ 8+8-6 \\ -8+8+8\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-14 \\ 10 \\ 8\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
